independence.source_reference: Independent SQLite SELECT across supplied databases for selected session tables; never uses Moect enumeration or message-build functions. Physical rowid/declared primary key, nine raw fields, occurrence counts and explicit time exclusions retained.
independence.saved_export_reconciliation: Reads persisted exports, not exporter return counts. Saved exports are bound by their hashes before final organizer verification.
independence.final_export_closure: Independently enumerates JSON/JSONL top-level, quote and forward payload nodes, verifies copied export hashes, retained source fields, final display labels, time interpretation and exact parent/root relationships.
independence.independent_review: Fresh reviewers were read-only against production; two demonstrated counterexamples were fixed and rerun using the unchanged reproducer.
independence.qualification: Independent comparison logic is not an independent implementation of every complex Moect renderer; those semantics require actual source/context review.
